examples.text: n'atthi kiccaṃ brāhmaṇassa, katakicco hi brāhmaṇo, yāva na gādhaṃ labhati nadīsu, āyūhati sabbagattebhi jantu, gādhañ'ca laddhāna thale ṭhito yo, n'āyūhatī pāragato hi so'va.
gat'addhino visokassa, vippamuttassa sabbadhi, sabbaganthappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.

examples.text: das'uttaraṃ pavakkhāmi, dhammaṃ nibbānapattiyā, dukkhass'antakiriyāya, sabbaganthappamocanaṃ.

58805.meaning1: freed from all bonds; liberated from all ties

examples.text: sa ve sabb'ābhibhū dhīro, sabbaganthappamocano, phuṭṭhassa paramā santi, nibbānaṃ akutobhayaṃ.

58806.meaning1: eliminated all ties; abandoned all bonds

examples.text: sabbaganthappahīnassa, vippamuttassa te sato, samaṇassa na taṃ sādhu, yadaññam'anusāsasī'ti.
gat'addhino visokassa, vippamuttassa sabbadhi, sabbaganthappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.

58807.meaning1: all the fragrant substances; all the perfumes
58807.meaning2: all the fragrant substances; all the perfumes

examples.text: eten'upāyena pañcahi yugasatehi rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ veṭhetvā āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjitvā sabbagandhānaṃ citakaṃ karitvā rañño cakkavattissa sarīraṃ jhāpenti.

58808.meaning1: all of the perfumed water; all the scented water
58808.meaning2: all the perfumed water; all the scented water

examples.text: kosinārakā'pi mallā sabbagandh'odakena bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesuṃ.

vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho. sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi akampaniyo nisabho, so idha usabho'ti adhippeto. idam'pi hi tassa pariyāyavacanaṃ.

58810.meaning1: who has severed all bonds to the household life; who has cut all ties to lay-life

examples.text: yaṃ gihissa'pi tadatthajotakaṃ, pabbajjam'pi ca tad'ādhigacchati, khajjabhojjarasalābhi'r'uttamaṃ, āhu sabbagihibandhanacchidan'ti.

58811.meaning1: all parts; all factors; all aspects
58811.meaning2: all parts; all factors; all aspects

examples.text: evaṃ sabb'aṅgasampannaṃ, muniṃ dukkhassa pāraguṃ, anek'ākārasampannaṃ, payirupāsanti gotaman'ti.

58812.commentary: (VVa) sabb'aṅgakalyāṇī'ti n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā atikkantā mānusavaṇṇaṃ appattā dibbavaṇṇan'ti evaṃ vuttehi sabbehi aṅgehi kāraṇehi, sabbehi vā aṅgapaccaṅgehi kalyāṇī sobhanā sundarā. (PVa) sabb'aṅgakalyāṇī'ti sabbehi aṅgehi sundare, sobhana-sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgī'ti attho.

examples.text: yaṃ me atthi kataṃ puññaṃ, arahantesu tādisu, taṃ me sabb'aṅgakalyāṇi, tayā saddhiṃ vipaccataṃ.
daddallamānā yasasā yasassinī, nāvāya ca tvaṃ avalamba tiṭṭhasi, āḷārapamhe hasite piyaṃvade, sabb'aṅgakalyāṇi bhusaṃ virocasi.

58813.meaning1: with all parts; including all features
58813.meaningLit: having all major and minor limbs

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā sati rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe vā phalake bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgaṃ.

58814.meaning1: with all parts; including all features
58814.meaningLit: having all major and minor limbs
58814.construction:
sabba + aṅga + paccaṅga + ī
sabbaṅgapaccaṅga + ī

examples.text: saññā nu kho, manomayaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ ahīn'indriyan'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.

58815.meaning1: endowed with all (the good) qualities; possessing all the factors

examples.text: evaṃ sabb'aṅgasampannaṃ, muniṃ dukkhassa pāraguṃ, anek'ākārasampannaṃ, payirupāsanti gotaman'ti.

58816.meaning1: whole mind; whole heart; all intention
58816.commentary: (MNa) sabbacetasā samannāharitvā'ti appamattakam'pi vikkhepaṃ akaronto sakalacittena samannāharitvā.
58816.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti
balatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa yaṃ tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhiṃkatvā manasikatvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.

58817.meaning1: all clothes; everything one is wearing

examples.text: te tadah'uposathe sāvakaṃ evaṃ samādapenti, ehi tvaṃ, ambho purisa, sabbacelāni nikkhipitvā evaṃ vadehi, n'āhaṃ kvacani kassaci kiñcanat'asmiṃ, na ca mama kvacani katthaci kiñcanat'atthī'ti.

58818.commentary: (VINa) tasmā yaṃ sen'āsanaṃ upari pañcahi chadanehi aññena vā kenaci sabbam'eva paṭicchannaṃ, ayaṃ sabbacchannā nāma seyyā

examples.text: seyyā nāma sabbacchannā, sabbaparicchannā, yebhuyyenacchannā, yebhuyyena paricchannā.
atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsu pokkharaṇīsu evarūpaṃ mālaṃ ropāpeyyaṃ uppalaṃ padumaṃ kumudaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ sabb'otukaṃ sabbajanassa anāvaṭan'ti.

58820.meaning1: victor over all; universal conqueror; master of existence
58820.commentary: (SNa) sabbajī'ti ek'aṃsena sabbavaṭṭaṃ jinitvā abhibhavitvā ṭhito'smī'ti vadati.

examples.text: idha kho taṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammā vadamāno vadeyya, idaṃ jātu vedagū, idaṃ jātu sabbajī, idaṃ jātu apalikhataṃ gaṇḍamūlaṃ palikhaṇin'ti

yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ samudayañ'ca atthaṅ'gamañ'ca assādañ'ca ādīnavañ'ca nissaraṇañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādāvimutto hoti, evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sabbajī hoti.

58823.meaning1: leaving everything behind; giving up everything; abandoning all

examples.text: sabb'ābhibhū sabbavidū'ham'asmi, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto, sabbañ'jaho taṇhakkhaye vimutto, sayaṃ abhiññāya kam'uddiseyyaṃ.
sabb'ābhibhuṃ sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalittaṃ, sabbañ'jahaṃ taṇhākkhaye vimuttaṃ, tam'ahaṃ naraṃ ekavihārī'ti brūmī'ti.

58824.commentary: (PM) katamaṃ tathāgatassa sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ? sabbaṃ saṅkhatamasaṅkhataṃ anavasesaṃ jānātī'ti, sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ. tattha āvaraṇaṃ n'atthī'ti, anāvaraṇañāṇaṃ.

examples.text: vimokkh'antikam'etaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ bodhiyā mūle saha sabbaññutaññāṇassa paṭilābhā sacchikā paññatti yadidaṃ bhagavā'ti, metteyyā'ti bhagavā.
katamaṃ tathāgatassa sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ? sabbaṃ saṅkhatam'asaṅkhataṃ anavasesaṃ jānātī'ti, sabbaññutaññāṇaṃ.
kiṃ me ekena tiṇṇena, purisena thāmadassinā, sabbaññutaṃ pāpuṇitvā, santāressaṃ sadevakaṃ.

58828.meaning1: omniscient; all knowing; with complete understanding

examples.text: pūraṇo, bho gotama, kassapo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti, carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan'ti.
kathaṃ carahi sabbaññū, vanditabbā tathāgatā, kathaṃ avandiyā buddhā, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.

58829.meaning1: omniscient one; who is all knowing; who understands everything; epithet of the Buddha

examples.text: sabbaññū sabbadassāvī, jino ācariyo mama, mahākāruṇiko satthā, sabbalokatikicchako.
kathaṃ carahi sabbaññū, vanditabbā tathāgatā, kathaṃ avandiyā buddhā, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito.
evaṃ virattaṃ khem'attaṃ, sabbasaṃyojan'ātigaṃ, anvesaṃ sabbaṭṭhānesu, mārasenā'pi n'ājjhagā'ti.

58832.meaning1: all states of being; (or) all points of view

examples.text: pajjotakaro ativijjha, sabbaṭṭhitīnaṃ atikkamam'addasa, ñatvā ca sacchikatvā ca, aggaṃ so desayi das'addhānaṃ.

58833.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sabba

examples.text: yato yato mano nivāraye, na dukkham'eti naṃ tato tato, sa sabbato mano nivāraye, sa sabbato dukkhā pamuccati.
na sabbato mano nivāraye, na mano saṃyatattam'āgataṃ, yato yato ca pāpakaṃ, tato tato mano nivāraye'ti.

58834.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sabba
58834.meaning1: in every direction; from all sides; in every way
58834.meaning2: from every side, in every respect

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ, anantaṃ sabbatopabhaṃ, ettha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati.

58835.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of sabba
58835.meaning1: as everything; from everything; apart from everything

examples.text: sabbaṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, sabbato abhiññāya yāvatā sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya sabbaṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbasmiṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbato n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbaṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, sabbaṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.
504, 470. sabbato uṃ iṃsu.

58837.meaning1: radiant in every direction; luminous all around; (comm) able to be crossed from anywhere
58837.commentary: (DNa) pabhan'ti pan'etaṃ kira titthassa nāmaṃ, tañ'hi papan'ti etthā'ti papaṃ, pakārassa pana bhakāro kato. sabbato pabham'assā'ti sabbatopabhaṃ. nibbānassa kira yathā mahāsamuddassa yato yato otaritu'kāmā honti, taṃ tadeva titthaṃ, atitthaṃ nāma n'atthi. evam'eva aṭṭhatiṃsāya kammaṭṭhānesu yena yena mukhena nibbānaṃ otaritu'kāmā honti, taṃ tadeva titthaṃ, nibbānassa atitthaṃ nāma n'atthi. tena vuttaṃ sabbatopabhan'ti.

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ, anantaṃ sabbatopabhaṃ, ettha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati.

sabbaṃ kho ahaṃ, brahme, sabbato abhiññāya yāvatā sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ tadabhiññāya sabbaṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbasmiṃ n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbato n'āp'ahosiṃ sabbaṃ me'ti n'āp'ahosiṃ, sabbaṃ n'ābhivadiṃ.

58839.meaning1: to all beings; encompassing all living beings
58839.commentary: (PMa) sabb'attatāyā'ti sabbesu hīna-majjhim'ukkaṭṭha-mitta-sapatta-majjhatt'ādi-ppabhedesu attatāya, ayaṃ parasatto'ti vibhāgaṃ akatvā attasamatāyā'ti vuttaṃ hoti. atha vā sabb'attatāyā'ti sabbena cittabhāvena, īsakam'pi bahi avikkhipamāno'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: iti uddham'adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
dullabho puris'ājañño, na so sabbattha jāyati, yattha so jāyati dhīro, taṃ kulaṃ sukham'edhati.
sabbattha munī anissito, na piyaṃ kubbati no'pi appiyaṃ, tasmiṃ paridevamaccharaṃ, paṇṇe vāri yathā na limpati.

58841.meaning1: in every way; in every respect; entirely

examples.text: āvilacitto anāvilaṃ, sarajo vītarajaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ, sabbattha vimuttamānasaṃ, kiṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi.

58842.meaning1: (gram) in all cases; in all instances

examples.text: 506, 496. sabbatth'āsass'ādilopo ca.
sabbattha vibhattipaccayesu asa'icc'etassa dhātussa ādissa lopo hoti vā. siyā, santi, sante, samāno. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? asi.

58844.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sabbatthaka
58844.construction:
sabba + ttha + ka + aṃ
sabbatthaka + aṃ

examples.text: snehaparetā'ti udakasinehena parigatā. santarabāhirā'ti saddhiṃ antopadesena c'eva bahipadesena ca, sabbatthakam'eva udakasinehena phuṭā'ti attho.

58845.meaning1: understanding of the paths of practice which lead to all destinations

58846.meaning1: path of practice leading to all destinations

examples.text: imesañ'ca pan'āhaṃ, āvuso, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā sabbatthagāminippaṭipadaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāmī'ti.

58848.meaning1: going everywhere; leading to all destinations

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, tathāgato sabbatthagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.

58849.meaning1: undefeated everywhere; unconquered in every respect
58849.commentary: (SNa) sabbattha'm'aparājito'ti sabbesu rāg'ādīsu vā mārayuddhe vā ajito.

examples.text: etādisāni katvāna, sabbattha'm'aparājitā, sabbattha sotthiṃ gacchanti, taṃ tesaṃ maṅgalam'uttaman'ti.
atthi sakyakule jāto, buddho appaṭipuggalo, sabb'ābhibhū māranudo, sabbattha'm'aparājito.

58850.meaning1: always useful; always beneficial; ever advantageous
58850.commentary: (SNa) satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti loṇadhūpanaṃ viya sabbakammik'āmaccaṃ viya ca sabbattha icchitabbaṃ vadāmī'ti attho. yathā hi loṇadhūpanaṃ sabbabyañjanesupi nivisati, yathā ca sabbakammiko amacco yodhakammam'pi karoti mantakammam'pi paṭihārakammam'pī'ti sabbakiccāni sādheti, evaṃ uddhatassa cittassa niggaṇhanaṃ, līnassa paggaṇhananti sabbam'etaṃ satiyā ijjhati, na sakkā vinā satiyā etaṃ sampādetuṃ, tasmā evam'āha. imasmiṃ sutte pubbabhāgavipassanā bojjhaṅgāva kathitā.

examples.text: satiñ'ca khv'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, sabb'atthikaṃ vadāmī'ti.

58852.meaning1: in every way; in every case

examples.text: yo c'āvuso hetu yo ca paccayo cakkhuviññāṇassa uppādāya so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ aparisesā nirujjheyya, api nū kho cakkhuviññāṇaṃ paññāyethā'ti?
evaṃ sabbathā'pi karuṇāyitvā vuttanayen'eva attani piyapuggale majjhatte verimhī'ti catūsu janesu sīmāsambhedaṃ katvā

ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhu'pi tehi dhammehi sabbenasabbaṃ sabbathāsabbaṃ samannāgato yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho'ti?
kiṃdado balado hoti, kiṃdado hoti vaṇṇado, kiṃdado sukhado hoti, kiṃdado hoti cakkhudo, ko ca sabbadado hoti, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito'ti.
so ca sabbadado hoti, yo dadāti upassayaṃ, amataṃ dado ca so hoti, yo dhammam'anusāsatī'ti.

58856.meaning1: all stress, fatigue and discomfort; all anxiety, weariness and distress

examples.text: tam'enaṃ passeyya aparena samayena taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nhāyitvā ca pivitvā ca sabba-daratha-kilamatha-pariḷāhaṃ paṭippassambhetvā paccuttaritvā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe nisinnaṃ vā nipannaṃ vā, ek'antasukhā vedanā vedayamānaṃ.
sabbaññū sabbadassāvī, jino ācariyo mama, mahākāruṇiko satthā, sabbalokatikicchako.
pūraṇo, bho gotama, kassapo sabbaññū sabbadassāvī aparisesaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paṭijānāti, carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca satataṃ samitaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ paccupaṭṭhitan'ti.
kiṃ kayirā udapānena, āpā ce sabbadā siyuṃ, taṇhāya mūlato chetvā, kissa pariyesanaṃ care'ti.
bālasaṅgatacārī hi, dīgham'addhāna socati, dukkho bālehi saṃvāso, amitten'eva sabbadā, dhīro ca sukhasaṃvāso, ñātīnaṃ'va samāgamo.

58860.meaning1: all suffering; all pain; all stress; all discomfort
58860.commentary: (SNa) sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti, na kevalaṃ seyyo'va hoti, na ca kevalaṃ paññaṃ labhati, sokamajjhe na socati, ñātimajjhe virocati, sugatiyaṃ nibbattati, ciraṃ sukhaṃ tiṭṭhati, sakalasmā pana vaṭṭadukkhā'pi muccatī'ti.

examples.text: evamesā kasī kaṭṭhā, sā hoti amatapphalā, etaṃ kasiṃ kasitvāna, sabbadukkhā pamuccatī'ti.
sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.

58861.meaning1: wearing away of all suffering; extinction of all stress; termination of all tension
58861.commentary: (MNa) sabbadukkhakkhaye ñāṇaṃ nāma arahattamagge ñāṇaṃ, imasmiṃ pana sutte arahattaphale ñāṇaṃ adhippetaṃ.

examples.text: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena paññ'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. esā hi, bhikkhu, paramā ariyā paññā yadidaṃ, sabbadukkhakkhaye ñāṇaṃ.

58862.meaning1: for the sake of the complete extinction of all suffering

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ sithilam'ārabbha, na'y'idaṃ appena thāmasā, nibbānaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, sabbadukkhappamocanaṃ.

58864.meaning1: giving up all suffering; letting go of all discomfort; abandoning of all pain

examples.text: eso hi bhagavā buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati, sabbadukkhappahānāya, dhammaṃ deseti pāṇinaṃ, tass'āhaṃ santikaṃ gacchaṃ, so me satthā bhavissati.

58865.meaning1: surpassed all suffering; transcended all discomfort

examples.text: atthi nu kho, bhante, taṃ cakkhu, yena cakkhunā atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivaṭṭe paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya

58866.meaning1: surpassed all suffering; transcended all discomfort

examples.text: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātito'pi anussarissati

58867.meaning1: which dispels all suffering; which drives out all dissatisfaction

examples.text: aṅgīrasassa nam'atthu, sakyaputtassa sirīmato, yo imaṃ dhammaṃ desesi, sabbadukkh'āpanūdanaṃ.

58868.meaning1: all fear of bad destinations; all danger of hell; (comm) fear of all human misfortune

examples.text: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggatibhayaṃ samatikkanto hotī'ti.

58869.meaning1: all fear of bad destinations and states of suffering; all danger of hell and the lower realms; (comm) all fear of human misfortune and the four hells
58869.commentary: (SNa) sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṃ samatikkanto'ti manussadobhaggena saddhiṃ cattāro apāyā paṭikkhittā.

examples.text: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sabbaduggativinipātabhayaṃ samatikkanto hotī'ti.

58870.meaning1: all the doors; i.e. body, speech and mind

58871.meaning1: everything; all things; all mental phenomena; all states of mind; all teachings
58871.commentary: (ANa) pāragū sabbadhammānan'ti sabbadhammā vuccanti pañcakkhandhā dvādas'āyatanāni aṭṭhārasa dhātuyo, tesaṃ sabbadhammānaṃ abhiññāpāraṃ, pariññāpāraṃ, pahānapāraṃ, bhāvanāpāraṃ, sacchikiriyāpāraṃ, samāpattipārañ'cā'ti chabbidhaṃ pāraṃ gatattā pāragū.

examples.text: kāmesu n'ābhigijjheyya, manas'ānāvilo siyā, kusalo sabbadhammānaṃ, sato bhikkhu paribbaje'ti.
jhāyiṃ virajam'āsīnaṃ, katakiccaṃ anāsavaṃ, pāraguṃ sabbadhammānaṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūhi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.

58872.meaning1: discourse of the root cause of all things
58872.commentary: (MNa) sabbadhammamūlapariyāyan'ti sabbesaṃ dhammānaṃ mūlapariyāyaṃ… sabbesaṃ dhammānaṃ kāraṇadesanan'ti vā evaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: sabbadhammamūlapariyāyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.

58873.grammar: masc pl, comp, gen pl of sabbadhammā, irreg form of sabbadhammānaṃ
58873.meaning1: of everything; of all things; of all mental phenomena; of all states of mind
58873.construction:
sabba + dhammā + ānaṃ
sabbadhammā + āna(ṃ) > sabbadhammāna
58873.commentary: (ANa) sabbadhammānapāragun'ti sabbesaṃ khandh'āyatanadhātudhammānaṃ abhiññāpāragū, pariññāpāragū, pahānapāragū, bhāvanāpāragū, sacchikiriyāpāragū, samāpattipāragū'ti chabbidhena pāragamanena pāragataṃ pārappattaṃ matthakappattaṃ.

examples.text: yaṃ manussā namassanti, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ, devā'pi taṃ namassanti, iti me arahato sutaṃ.
aññātam'etaṃ vacanaṃ, asitassa yathātathaṃ, taṃ taṃ gotama pucchāmi, sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ.

58874.meaning1: (gram) belonging to the 'all roots' class of verbal endings; having verbal endings of four tenses (i.e. aorist, imperative, optative and present)

examples.text: 431, 458. hiyyattanī sattamī pañcamī vattamānā sabbadhātukaṃ.
hiyyattan'ādayo catasso vibhattiyo sabbadhātukasaññā honti. agamā, gaccheyya, gacchatu, gacchati.

58875.meaning1: everywhere; in every way; in all respects

examples.text: gat'addhino visokassa, vippamuttassa sabbadhi, sabbaganthappahīnassa, pariḷāho na vijjati.
iti uddham'adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati.

tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahako tasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe sabbanavako hoti. atha kho āyasmā mahako āyasmantaṃ theraṃ etadavoca, sādhu khv'assa, bhante thera, sītako ca vāto vāyeyya, abbhasampilāpo ca assa, devo ca ekam'ekaṃ phusāyeyyā'ti.
evaṃ liṅga, sabbanāma, pada, upasagga, nipāta, taddhita, ākhyāta, kammappavacanīy'ādisaññā ca.

58878.meaning1: all objects; all signs; all mental images
58878.commentary: (MNa) sabbanimittānan'ti rūp'ādīnaṃ sabb'ārammaṇānaṃ. (ANa) sabbanimittesū'ti rūpanimittaṃ, saddanimittaṃ, gandhanimittaṃ, rasanimittaṃ, phoṭṭhabbanimittaṃ, sassatādinimittaṃ, puggalanimittaṃ dhammanimittan'ti evarūpesu ca bahiddhā sabbanimittesu.

examples.text: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā… bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā n'āssu

kati pan'āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā'ti? tayo kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā ṭhitiyā, sabbanimittānañ'ca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro, pubbe ca abhisaṅkhāro.

58879.meaning1: letting go of everything; giving up everything; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: n'āññatra bojjhā tapasā, n'āññatr'indriyasaṃvarā, n'āññatra sabbanissaggā, sotthiṃ passāmi pāṇinan'ti.

58880.meaning1: all abodes of beings; every sphere of existence; all states of being
58880.commentary: (SNa) sabbanivesanesū'ti tayo bhavā, catasso yoniyo, pañca gatiyo, satta viññāṇaṭṭhitiyo, nava satt'āvāsā, iti imesu'pi sabbesu sattanivesanesu evarūpaṃ khīṇ'āsavaṃ kāyassa bhedā uppajjamānaṃ vā uppannaṃ vā na passantī'ti attho.

examples.text: pahāsi saṅkhaṃ na vimānam'ajjhagā, acchecchi taṇhaṃ idha nāmarūpe, taṃ chinnaganthaṃ anighaṃ nirāsaṃ, pariyesamānā n'ājjhagamuṃ, devā manussā idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā sabbanivesanesu.
ye sabbanihīnaṃ kāyaṃ paripūrenti, te gandhabbakāyaṃ paripūrentī'ti.

58882.meaning1: entire; whole; complete; (or) at the very end of
58882.synonym: kasiṇa, kiṇha, kevala, kevalakappa, nissesa, sakala, sabbāvant

examples.text: atha kho, mahārāja ghaṭikāraṃ kumbhakāraṃ aḍḍhamāsaṃ pītisukhaṃ na vijahati, satt'āhaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ. atha kho, mahārāja, āvesanaṃ sabb'antaṃ temāsaṃ ākāsacchadanaṃ aṭṭhāsi, na devo'tivassi.

58883.meaning1: very last of all; at the very minimum

examples.text: yattakā bhikkhū tassa uposathakammassa pattayuttā anurūpā, sabb'antimena paricchedena cattāro bhikkhū pakatattā
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

58884.meaning1: all border; all the frontier; all outlying
58884.commentary: (VINa) anujānāmi bhikkhave sabbapaccantimesu janapadesu guṇaṅ'guṇ'ūpāhanan'ti ettha manussacammaṃ ṭhapetvā yena kenaci cammena upāhanā vaṭṭati. upāhanakosaka-satthakosaka-kuñcikakosakesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: anāpatti samaye, addhamāsaṃ nahāyati, atirekaddhamāsaṃ nahāyati, pāraṃ gacchanto nahāyati, sabbapaccantimesu janapadesu, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

sabbapaṭhamaṃ tāva kiñci'd'eva karuṇāyitabbarūpaṃ… hatthapādehi paggharantakimigaṇaṃ aṭṭassaraṃ karontaṃ disvā, kicchaṃ vat'āyaṃ satto āpanno, app'eva nāma imamhā dukkhā mucceyyā'ti karuṇā pavattetabbā.

58889.meaning1: all proponents of other belief systems

examples.text: desanāvilāsamayo c'eva puññ'ussayo ca. tena h'esa mah'ānubhāvo bhisakko dibbāgadena sappe viya sabbaparappavādino sadevakañ'ca lokaṃ abhibhavati. iti sabb'ālok'ābhibhavane tatho aviparīto desanāvilāsamayo c'eva puññ'ussayo ca agado assā'ti.

58890.commentary: (VINa) yaṃ pana sen'āsanaṃ bhūmito paṭṭhāya yāva chadanaṃ āhacca pākārena vā aññena vā kenaci antamaso vatthen'āpi parikkhittaṃ, ayaṃ sabbaparicchannā nāma seyyā.

examples.text: seyyā nāma sabbacchannā, sabbaparicchannā, yebhuyyenacchannā, yebhuyyena paricchannā.

vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho. sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi akampaniyo nisabho, so idha usabho'ti adhippeto. idam'pi hi tassa pariyāyavacanaṃ.

58893.meaning1: overcoming all dangers; surmounting all difficulties

examples.text: vajasatajeṭṭhako vā usabho, vajasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho. sabbagavaseṭṭho sabbaparissayasaho seto pāsādiko mahābhāravaho asanisatasaddehi'pi akampaniyo nisabho, so idha usabho'ti adhippeto. idam'pi hi tassa pariyāyavacanaṃ.

58894.meaning1: who only uses items from the rubbish
58894.commentary: (VINa) catūsu paccayesu antamaso dantakaṭṭham'pi sabbaṃ paṃsukūlam'eva assā'ti sabbapaṃsukūliko.

58895.meaning1: compassionate for the well-being of all breathing beings

examples.text: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati, sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī, byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇ'ātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇ'ātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho, lajjī day'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī vihāsiṃ.

58896.construction:
sabba + pāṇa + bhūta + ā
sabbapāṇabhūta + ā

examples.text: kathañ'ca, gahapatayo, tividhaṃ kāyena adhammacariyāvisamacariyā hoti? idha, gahapatayo, ekacco pāṇ'ātipātī hoti, luddo lohitapāṇi hatappahate niviṭṭho aday'āpanno sabbapāṇabhūtesu.
byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahit'ānukampī, byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
pabbajam'pi ca anomanikkamo, aggataṃ vajati sabbapāṇinaṃ, tena uttaritaro na vijjati, sabbalokam'abhibhuyya viharatī'ti.
mettāvihārino ete, hitesī sabbapāṇinaṃ, anatt'ukkaṃsakā sabbe, na te vambhenti kassaci.

58899.meaning1: all evil deeds; all wrongdoing; all unwholesome action
58899.meaning2: all evil deed; all crimes; all wrongdoing

examples.text: sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalass'ūpasampadā, sacittapariyodapanaṃ, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.
